data.name: ExternalIdStatusRejected
data.value: This object was not created due to an import error. The external ID shown is from the source data.

data.name: ExternalIdStatusPendingRemoval
data.value: This object has been detected as deleted from the source system. It is pending removal during the next synchronisation.

data.name: ExternalIdStatusDeleted
data.value: This object has been deleted. The external ID shown is preserved from when this operation was recorded.

data.name: ExternalIdStatusOther
data.value: The external ID shown is preserved from when this operation was recorded.

data.name: OperationAdded
data.value: A new Connected System Object was discovered in the source system and added to the connector space.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationUpdated
data.value: An existing Connected System Object was updated with changed attribute values from the source system.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDeletedImport
data.value: The object was detected as deleted from the source system. It is now pending removal during the next synchronisation.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDeletedSync
data.value: The deletion of this object has been processed during synchronisation. Associated metaverse links and data have been updated.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationProjected
data.value: A new Metaverse Object was created because no existing match was found. The Connected System Object's attributes were projected into the metaverse.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationJoined
data.value: The Connected System Object was matched to an existing Metaverse Object using the configured join rules.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationAttributeFlow
data.value: Attribute values were flowed from the Connected System Object to the Metaverse Object according to the Synchronisation Rule mappings.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDisconnected
data.value: The Connected System Object was disconnected from its Metaverse Object. Attribute Flow has stopped.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDisconnectedOutOfScope
data.value: The object fell out of scope of the import Synchronisation Rule scoping criteria and was disconnected from the metaverse.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationOutOfScopeRetainJoin
data.value: The object fell out of scope but the join was retained. Attribute Flow has stopped, but the link is preserved for future re-scoping.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDriftCorrection
data.value: Drift was detected: the target system's values differed from the expected metaverse values. A corrective Pending Export was created to restore the expected state.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationExported
data.value: The pending attribute changes were successfully exported to the target Connected System.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationDeprovisioned
data.value: The object was deleted from the target Connected System as part of deprovisioning.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationPendingExport
data.value: A Pending Export is staged and waiting for the next export run to apply changes to the target system.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationPendingExportConfirmed
data.value: The Pending Export was confirmed during the confirming import. The exported values matched the imported values.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationCreated
data.value: The Metaverse Object was created directly (e.g. via data generation or the admin interface) rather than through synchronisation.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationExportScopeReview
data.value: This Metaverse Object was reviewed against the export Synchronisation Rules, because an export rule changed or the object was created or changed outside synchronisation. It was provisioned or deprovisioned as the rules now require, or had values changed outside synchronisation delivered to its accounts.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationNoChange
data.value: The object was evaluated but no changes were necessary. The existing values already match the expected state.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: OperationOther
data.value: An operation was performed on this object.
data.comment: Tooltip explaining what an operation on an object means.

data.name: WritabilityWritableDescription
data.value: The Connected System accepts writes to this attribute, so an export Attribute Flow can keep it up to date.

data.name: WritabilityReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The Connected System will not accept writes to this attribute. It can be imported, but no export Attribute Flow may target it.

data.name: WritabilityWritableOnCreateDescription
data.value: The Connected System accepts a value for this attribute only when the object is created. An export Attribute Flow may target it: the value is sent with the Create Pending Export, and JIM never sends it again, because changing it would break the link to the object.

data.name: TermMetaverseName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermMetaverseText
data.value: The central, authoritative repository within JIM. The Metaverse holds one Metaverse Object for each real-world thing JIM manages, aggregated from every Connected System via Synchronisation Rules.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermConnectorSpaceName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermConnectorSpaceText
data.value: The staging area where Connected System Objects reside before and after synchronisation. The Connector Space acts as a buffer between external systems and the Metaverse, ensuring that changes are validated before they are applied.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermProjectionName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermProjectionText
data.value: Creating a new Metaverse Object when no existing one matches an incoming Connected System Object. Projection is enabled per Synchronisation Rule.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermJoinName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermJoinText
data.value: Linking a Connected System Object to an existing Metaverse Object. A Join happens when an Object Matching Rule finds that an incoming Connected System Object corresponds to one that already exists.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermAttributeFlowName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermAttributeFlowText
data.value: A rule that maps an attribute between a Connected System Object and a Metaverse Object. Attribute Flows define how data moves during synchronisation, including any transformations applied via expressions.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermPendingExportName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermPendingExportText
data.value: A queued change waiting to be sent to a target system. Pending Exports are created during synchronisation and held until an export Run Profile is executed, at which point they are applied to the Connected System.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermObjectMatchingRuleName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermObjectMatchingRuleText
data.value: A rule that decides whether an incoming Connected System Object corresponds to an existing Metaverse Object. Import matching joins a Connected System Object to a Metaverse Object; export matching joins a Metaverse Object being provisioned to an account that already exists in the target system, rather than creating a duplicate.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermScopingName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermScopingText
data.value: The Scoping Criteria that decide which objects a Synchronisation Rule applies to. While an object is outside them, the rule flows nothing for it; when a joined object leaves them, the rule's Out-of-Scope Action (import rules) or Deprovisioning Action (export rules) decides what happens next.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermContainerScopeName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermContainerScopeText
data.value: How far beneath a selected Container objects are imported from: the whole subtree beneath it (the default), or only the objects held directly within it.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

data.name: TermAttributePriorityName
data.comment: A JIM term's display name in a term hint popover.

data.name: TermAttributePriorityText
data.value: The deterministic precedence that decides which Connected System's value wins when several contribute the same Metaverse Object attribute. Each contributing inbound Synchronisation Rule holds a priority for the attribute, and the highest-priority contributor that has a value sets it, so the result never depends on the order synchronisations happen to run in.
data.comment: A JIM term's definition in a term hint popover. The English is held verbatim in step with the documentation glossary.

Delivering it applies the provisioning Synchronisation Rule's Initial Password settings for enabling the Connected System Object and for whether its password never expires.
